description: Source code for the omi_proxy class implementing D-Bus communication, signal handling, and bundle management in the omi namespace.

classes.name: OmiProxy
classes.description: A class managing D-Bus communication, signal handling, and bundle operations for OMI.

methods.name: ~OmiProxy
methods.description: Destructor that stops the main loop, joins the signal monitor thread, and releases resources.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its ID and file paths, returning the bundle path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle by its ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a unique tag.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered listener by its tag.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the proxy object, creating the D-Bus proxy and starting the signal monitor thread.

methods.name: startSignalMonitorThread
methods.description: Starts the thread that monitors D-Bus signals.

methods.name: signalMonitorThread
methods.description: Thread function that creates and runs the GLib main loop, handling signals.

methods.name: handleVerityFailed
methods.description: Invokes registered callbacks when a 'VerityFailed' signal is received.

methods.name: notifyThreadStarted
methods.description: Notifies that the signal monitor thread has started.
